summary: Iteration 47 e2e of three new changes: (A) Scheda persona: tabs reduced + inline edit + dedup; (B) Teams table 'Componenti' column + TeamMembersDialog; (C) StaffAssignSelect no-overlap in Pipeline & Checklist. TASK A fully passes. TASK B passes for display/filters/leader badge/name-link/remove but TWO issues on 'Aggiungi componente': (i) candidate list is NOT scoped to team-less people — it also includes members of OTHER teams of the same event; (ii) the 'Aggiungi componente' popover (team-add-popover) is intercepted by the team-members-dialog (z-index). TASK C passes in Checklist but FAILS in the Pipeline task-edit modal (same z-index issue — pipeline-task-dialog intercepts staff-add-new click inside StaffAssignSelect's PopoverContent).

ui_bugs.issue: Clicks on team-add-opt-* are intercepted by the parent Radix Dialog ('team-members-dialog' with z-[100]). PopoverContent has no explicit z-index so it renders behind the dialog. Items appear in DOM and are 'visible', but the dialog subtree intercepts pointer events, making +Aggiungi componente completely unusable.

ui_bugs.component: StaffAssignSelect > PopoverContent (staff-assign-popover) inside Pipeline task edit modal
ui_bugs.issue: When Responsabile is used inside the pipeline-task-dialog (Modifica attività), the PopoverContent (and its 'Aggiungi nuovo Staff' button) is intercepted by the dialog overlay — same z-index issue. Note: inside /pipeline/attenzione (no outer dialog) it works correctly.

integration_issues.issue: Spec: candidati = Staff/Volontari dell'evento NON già in alcun team. Actual: filter uses `l.team_id !== team.id`, so people in OTHER teams are included. For Team Run (1 member) the popover lists 7 candidates (Anna Bianchi, Marco Rossi, Luca Verdi, Paolo Gialli, Sara Neri from Ristori/Pacer + Giulia Viola + Davide Mora). Expected: only Giulia Viola and Davide Mora.

action_items: TeamMembersDialog + StaffAssignSelect: add explicit z-index to PopoverContent (e.g., className include 'z-[110]' or 'z-[200]') so that when a Popover is portaled inside a Radix Dialog it stacks above the dialog overlay. Current failure path (Playwright): the <td> or dialog element intercepts pointer events for buttons that are 'visible'. Fix in /app/frontend/src/components/TeamMembersDialog.jsx line ~120 (PopoverContent) and /app/frontend/src/components/StaffAssignSelect.jsx line ~75 (PopoverContent).

TeamMembersDialog candidates filter (/app/frontend/src/components/TeamMembersDialog.jsx lines 71-83): change the filter from `l.team_id !== team.id` to `(!l.team_id || l.team_id === team.id)` so that only people with NO team assignment on this event are offered as candidates (members of other teams must be excluded). Together with the existing `!inTeam.has(persona_id)` this gives the exact spec behavior.

After the two fixes above, retest: (a) Team Run +Aggiungi componente should list exactly Giulia Viola and Davide Mora; (b) Pipeline task edit modal > Responsabile > Aggiungi nuovo Staff should open the quick-add form inside the popover without the dialog intercepting clicks.
critical_code_review_comments: PersonDetailDialog.jsx inline edit: PhoneInput uses `numberInputProps={{ 'data-testid': 'person-edit-cellulare-input' }}` but react-phone-number-input renders the inner <input type='tel'> without forwarding the custom data-testid in a reliable way in this version. The outer wrapper's data-testid works. If tests on `person-edit-cellulare-input` are required by the spec, consider forwarding via the inputComponent prop or ref. Low priority.
PersonDetailDialog saveEdit: dedup logic runs TWO calls to /persons-match in sequence. Could be a single POST with {email, cellulare} to halve round-trips. Not a bug.

TeamMembersDialog candidates: logic selects people whose link has `team_id !== team.id`. This fails the spec requirement 'NON i membri di altri team già assegnati'. Must also exclude any member whose link has a non-empty team_id different from the current team.

TeamMembersDialog + StaffAssignSelect PopoverContent: no explicit z-index. When portaled inside a Radix Dialog (which uses z-[100]), the popover and its buttons are below the dialog subtree in stacking context, intercepting pointer events. Add z-[110]+ to PopoverContent in both files.

PUT /api/persons/{id} is called from the inline edit — the request body is well-shaped (nome/cognome/email/cellulare/data_nascita/codice_fiscale/note). Confirmed by UI that saved data is displayed in-place without closing the dialog.

rca of the issue: Both popover z-index bugs share one root cause: Radix PopoverContent, when portaled by a parent Radix Dialog, inherits default z-index (~z-50) while the Dialog uses z-[100]. The Dialog's content/overlay sits above the Popover, so even if the Popover is visually rendered, its interactive descendants are pointer-event-blocked by the dialog layer. Fix: raise z-index on both PopoverContents (e.g., className='w-72 p-0 z-[110]'). The candidates filter bug is a simple logical oversight — `l.team_id !== team.id` wrongly keeps other-team members. Fix: `(!l.team_id || l.team_id === team.id) && !inTeam.has(persona_id)`.
